core_obligations: Descend the data to finite-type Z-algebras via the four limits lemmas
Realize X inside P^n_B after twisting L and extend F to the closed X'
Conclude quasi-compactness of the P-piece as an open of a proper Noetherian Quot space

proof_roadmap.step: Descend the data to finite-type Z-algebras via the four limits lemmas
Realize X inside P^n_B after twisting L and extend F to the closed X'
Conclude quasi-compactness of the P-piece as an open of a proper Noetherian Quot space

difficulty_reason: Prove Quot^P_{F/X/B} is separated of finite presentation over B for separated fp X -> B, fp F, ample L: separatedness and lfp are inherited from the full Quot functor (lemma-quot-s-lfp), so only quasi-compactness of the open P-piece is at stake; reduce to B affine and descend X, F, L along Lambda = colim Lambda_i via four Limits-of-Spaces descent lemmas using Quot_F/X/B = B x_{B_i} Quot_{F_i/X_i/B_i}; then replace L by a positive power (lemma-quot-power-invertible) to realize X as an immersion into P^n_B with L = O(1)|_X, extend F to a finitely presented G on the closed X' subset P^n_B (properties-lemma-lift-finite-presentation), so Quot_{F/X/B} -> Quot_{G/X'/B} is an open immersion (lemma-quot-better-open) sending the P-piece into the P-piece; the target is proper over B (lemma-quot-proper-over-base) hence Noetherian, and an open of a Noetherian algebraic space is quasi-compact.
